limits: Idealized generated cases; no field validation or generalization claim
Finite approximation errors and solver failures remain included

metric_definitions.native_reconstruction: piecewise constant cell averages; right cell at an internal face
metric_definitions.paired_difference: adaptive minus baseline on the same seed
metric_definitions.reference_rms_tolerance_units: same SI units as the evaluated field
metric_definitions.seed_summary: descriptive mean and sample SD (ddof=1) of defined seeds
metric_definitions.time_alignment: exact requested output times; no interpolation
metric_definitions.velocity: q/h only on reference h_m > velocity_wet_threshold_m
metric_definitions.velocity_incomplete: null when any reference-wet candidate depth is zero; do not shrink the reference mask to improve the metric
metric_definitions.wave_band: abs(x - exact shock/front position) <= half width
metric_definitions.wave_band_boundary: inside at equality; outside is its complement
